title: 遺伝子工学
subtitle: Genetic Engineering
keywords: Genes and DNA 2.PCR 3.Cloning 4.DNA analysis 5.Gene data analysis
educationalGoal: This course will provide students with knowledge of genetic engineering. This course has two aims. The first is to teach students the basics of genetic engineering. The second is to introduce applications of genetic engineering.
advice: This course will include the following topics: 1) Basics of genetic engineering Enzymes (restriction enzymes, DNA ligase, etc.) Cloning vectors (plasmid vectors, phage vectors, etc.) Gene cloning (PCR, genome cloning, cDNA cloning) Transformation Gene analysis (hybridization analysis, blotting analyses) 2) Application of genetic engineering DNA microarray Next-generation sequencer Gene editing
books: Textbooks:Genetic Engineering 2nd ed. Reference books:Lewin’s Genes XLL Reserved books:Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: This course is an extension of the topics students learn in the “Basic Biology”, “Bioengineering” and “Molecular Biology” courses. Knowledge of DNA and RNA is required.
